design_probes.design_claim: Repeated Clean execution rejects a physically invalid candidate with typed hard-event evidence, may continue to one explicitly declared fallback, and publishes either one valid receipt or one atomic TELEMETRY-GAP without training-state mutation.
design_probes.necessary_capability: reject one hard-event candidate, execute two same-identity Clean repeats on the fallback, and publish one atomic typed result
design_probes.minimal_case: fresh prepared two-role batch per candidate, primary plus one fallback Scenario, K8, two repeat seeds, raw sensor fake
simplifications: Isaac scene and contact sensor effects are fake
design_probes.falsifier: a hard-event candidate becomes calibration evidence, prevents an explicit fallback, loses its event provenance, mutates protected state, leaks lifecycle, or leaves partial output
design_probes.success_witness: OFFICIAL_R1_PSEUDO_PASS after primary rejection, fallback completion, exact close IDs, typed event evidence and atomic result validation

route_edges.producer: strict v010 manifest and sealed Stage-1 prepared owner
route_edges.carrier: read-only transaction aggregate plus FrontRESCleanRawWindow and ReadOnlyCleanCollection

evidence.identity_receipt: same Scenario/K/cache/GMT/request hashes and two distinct repeat seeds
evidence.effect_receipt: two raw K8 Clean measurements reach one validated calibration receipt
evidence.persistence_receipt: atomic JSON failure leaves no final or temporary result

live_only_unknowns.fact: The unchanged train.py composition root with real IsaacLab reset and contact/ZMP telemetry either reaches a valid fallback calibration receipt or emits an atomic typed TELEMETRY-GAP on CUDA.
live_only_unknowns.why_offline_impossible: The local MOSAIC torch environment has no IsaacLab scene, PhysX contact sensor or server segment cache.
live_only_unknowns.falsifier: the official command crashes on a hard candidate, accepts it as noise, loses hard-event provenance, changes protected training state, leaks scenarios, or leaves partial output
live_only_unknowns.cost: 16 environments, at most two selected K8 Scenarios with two repeated Clean windows each, zero optimizer updates
live_only_unknowns.stop_condition: stop after the first receipt or first invariant failure; do not retry automatically
live_only_unknowns.zero_write_boundary: no Replay, optimizer, training checkpoint or Gain write; only the atomic evaluation result and log are permitted

live_attempts.first_invalid_boundary: the selected Clean candidate contained a hard Physics event and the campaign aborted instead of rejecting that candidate and trying an explicit fallback
